test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Anil said to Ria, “I know where everything is kept in the kitchen.”

options.text: Anil told Ria that he knows where everything was kept in the kitchen.
Anil told Ria that he knew where everything is kept in the kitchen.
Anil asked Ria that he knows where everything was kept in the kitchen.
Anil told Ria that he knew where everything was kept in the kitchen.

solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. Anil told Ria that he knew where everything was kept in the kitchen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In reported speech, present tense verbs are usually changed to their past tense forms.
 
• **"I know"** changes to** "he knew" **because "know" is in the present tense and must be changed to the past tense "knew."
 
• **"Is kept"** changes to "was kept" for the same reason, the present tense "is" changes to the past tense "was."
 
• The reporting verb "said to" changes to "told" since the sentence is an assertion, not a question.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
